cases.study_information: Predict the fold enhancement of PD1 reporter blockade produced by1.25nM humanVEGF-A165 in the source coculture bioassay. Define enhancement as IC50 withoutVEGF divided by IC50 withVEGF; larger values mean stronger conditional potency gain. Both conditions use antiCD3/PD-L1 aAPC CHO-K1 cells cocultured with PD1-effector cells for6h. Human/cynomolgus PD1SPR and cellularIC50 withoutVEGF are visible; the withVEGF values and all ratios for new constructs are withheld. AK112 is a visible reference. MissingSPR remainsblank. This is a context-effect prediction, not inference of clinical efficacy.

dependence_note: Shared sources must be interpreted at the study-family level.
title: Predicting VEGF-dependent enhancement of cellular PD1 blockade
